## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Implement only the owner-bound slice tested by AC-1 and AC-2, with
   admitted durable/wire compatibility and reuse of lower-layer
   codecs/stores: the §9.3 *existing-contract fix* "R0 open/finished
   mapping (R-2.9.3)" — `kernel.reproduce`'s R0 fold derives the
   `open`/`finished` lifecycle from `lifecycle.run.finished` presence
   (the producer's own rule, hh-bundle assemble.rs:182–187),
   independent of the finished row's outcome-plane `payload.status`
   (`succeeded`/`failed_honest`/`met`/…) — A3 F6; the recipient decode
   (`hh-bundle codec decode_dir`) refuses path/link escape (non-regular
   member entries incl. symlinks; a symlinked `bundle.json`) and
   resource expansion (member file larger than the manifest's declared
   `size`; undeclared/zero sizes bounded by the native blob bound)
   before bytes materialize (§6.3: "reject archive escaping
   paths/links and excessive expansion before execution").
2. Retain the regression/evidence and per-target acceptance mapping
   under `docs/build/runs/R5.24.md` and its PR record; index only
   actual results — clean-recipient verifyfixed (§8.1: pins original
   revision/input/recipe/rights, scratch copy, original failure
   preserved, comparable candidate evidence, regression fails without
   the fix; unavailable original bytes → labelled diagnostic
   equivalent, never an original-rerun claim).
3. Consume predecessor contracts unchanged — R5.21
   `evidence-package/1`, R5.22 `closure_walk`/`closure_report`, R5.23
   `population-receipt/1`, the landed `kernel.reproduce`/`check_completeness`
   report shapes. A new shared/persisted decision lands in the owning
   ADR admission (landing-record ADR, ADR-0024 rung — BL-47 set).

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-embed/src/bundle_ops.rs` — repair the R0 lifecycle fold
   (≈25 lines): derive `finished` iff any `lifecycle.run.finished`
   envelope, `open` iff lifecycle rows exist without one, `None`
   (inconclusive) when the export carries no lifecycle rows; drop the
   `payload.status` outcome read entirely (it is the F6 defect).
   Doc comment names the producer rule + the admitted fix.
2. `crates/hh-bundle/src/codec.rs` + `error.rs` — `decode_dir` refusals:
   `bundle.json`/member entries must be regular files (link escape →
   `MemberEscape`); a member file whose `metadata.len()` exceeds the
   declared index `size` (or `DEFAULT_BLOB_MAX_BYTES` when undeclared)
   refuses `MemberExpansion` before the bytes are read.
3. `crates/hh-embed/tests/r5_24.rs` — the six R0 controls + refusals +
   verifyfixed legs over a scratch producer rig (Store +
   `lifecycle.run.finished{status: succeeded|failed_honest}` appends →
   `hharness_bundle::assemble` → `encode_dir`) and a separate-recipient
   `EmbedService` (producer store deleted first — "after producer
   cleanup"); `kernel.reproduce{path, level}`/`kernel.check_completeness`
   invoked through a JSON argument file (the pinned handoff shape —
   `hh bundle validate|reproduce <dir> [--level R0]` rides the same
   ops).
4. Build-memory records: run ledger (this file), landing ADR-0402 +
   index/revisit-trigger regeneration + BL-47 home, dated coverage
   note, `docs/build/pr/R5.24.md`, closeout (BUILD_INDEX seq-194 row,
   LEDGER advance, ci-boundary record).
